column1: # Animation (CastType) ids to names.
# GENERATED FROM THE RUNNING GAME, 2026-08-29, by --animdump: read out of
# Data/Balance/Animation.dat through ActionWrapper.AnimationRow, whose rows are an
# array indexed by animation id with a stride of 106 bytes. Base confirmed by two
# different animations (474 and 268) agreeing on it. Do not hand-edit - re-run the
# dump after a patch and diff, which is the whole point of it being generated.
# WHAT IT REPLACED, because the shape of the error is worth keeping: the previous
# table was transcribed from the AHK tool's hand-maintained AnimationID.ahk, and it
# was not riddled with mistakes - it was a FAITHFUL table of an older patch. Three
# rows have since been inserted into the game's own file:
#     584  AbyssalLivingBomb      +1 from here
#     599  AbyssalPact            +2 from here
#     904  RemidusDive            +3 from here
# Every one of its 1084 rows fits one of those three shifts exactly, with zero
# leftovers - so 500 of them, 46%, named the wrong animation in the current game.
# 177 of those changed AnimationKind, and 37 were being classified QUIET when the
# real animation is not: ElectricSpit read as DodgeRollSprint, an empowered wyvern
# flame breath read as FixedRunLayerBaseForward. Those are threats the evasion
# filter dropped in silence, which is precisely the failure AnimationNames.IsQuiet
# is asked the safe way round to avoid - defeated not by a missing name but by a
# confident wrong one.
# A name is still a LABEL, never a fact - see AnimationNames - but it is now the
# game's label rather than a transcription of one.
